title: service-storage: a malformed, forged or expired token on the local adapter's signed byte routes answers 5xx INTERNAL instead of a 4xx refusal (`LocalStorageAdapter.verifyToken` throws a plain Error the two raw-byte handlers surface)
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named landing and a measured reach**, `reach:` an anonymous HTTP request carrying a malformed token to the local storage adapter's signed byte routes, measured on a booted showcase by PR #23137's anonymous sweep (`os-dev-report` `6137316611` on #22146, at `bf3ba9957`): it answers 5xx `INTERNAL`. Readers who act: triage, to route (`packages/services/*` is `domain:services`); then the owning seat.

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-justin` · session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`, from the #22146 dev report (out-of-scope finding 2). ⛔ Not a claim; grade and lane are triage's.

## What happens

- `packages/services/service-storage/src/local-storage-adapter.ts#verifyToken` (`:373` on `origin/main` `c9b5b24b0`) throws a plain `Error` for a malformed, a forged and an expired token alike (read from source).
- The two raw-byte handlers in `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts#registerStorageRoutes` (the PUT near `:1428` and the GET near `:1479`) call it and surface the throw as an internal error.
- So a caller holding a bad or stale signed URL is told the server failed, not that the token was refused. Only the malformed case was measured; the forged and expired cases are read from source.

## Acceptance

- A malformed, a forged and an expired token on either signed byte route answer a 4xx refusal with the error envelope (the code and status the storage family's other token refusals use), never 5xx. Reject-path tests assert `code` and `status` for each of the three.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included: `local storage signed url invalid token verifyToken 500 internal error` → 0 hits; `storage signed url token` → 0 hits. Control: `service-storage file download anonymous caller` → 1 hit (#22431, closed, a different storage defect), so the search reaches the storage family.

Dedupe words: storage token 500; verifyToken invalid token internal error; local storage signed url status; expired storage token 500.
